name: The tuning fork
note: Doc 23. Never leaves inventory -- doc 01 calls it the game's totem. IT IS NOT startsHeld AND A PUZZLE DOES GRANT IT: the case's PICK UP in Room 1 gives it, along with the letter and the four dollars. This note previously read 'it starts held and no puzzle grants it', which was true of neither -- the grant had been wired on the case and the note never re-checked against it, so both fired and the fork was carried before the case was lifted. Doc 23 note 4: the third LOOK is one of only two mentions of Thad's father in Act I; the other is Room 1's case. These lines SUPERSEDE the pair I wired from doc 10, which were the Room 34 hotspot's rather than the item's.

LOOK_AT.say: A tuning fork. Steel, A above middle C, and the only tool of my trade with any use out here.
repeat: There is a small dent in one tine. It has not affected the pitch, which I have checked more often than is reasonable.
My father put this in the case first. He packed it before the shirts.

LISTEN_TO.say: A. Four hundred and forty. Correct.
repeat: Correct. It is the only thing I own that is.

startsHeldNote: REMOVED.
